purpose: Provenance manifest for one-way vendor-copies from the old SignalFrame repo (spec §3.1, §7.3). Every entry records the source commit, source path, target path, copy-time sha256, and adaptation note. The old repo is NEVER modified; copied code is maintained by this repo afterwards.
allowedSources: packages/crawler/src (SSRF/DNS-pinning crawl safety, static HTML fetch)
packages/audit/src/rules (implementations backing the 11 frozen MVP rules)

entries.adaptation: rewrote ./*.js import specifiers to ./*.ts; added spec §6.1 trailing-slash strip for non-root pathname
rewrote ./*.js import specifiers to ./*.ts; dropped `export * from "./pin-agent"` (pin-agent.ts not vendored — needs undici, deferred to crawl WP)

Vendored the regex HTML extraction helpers (attr/firstTag/tagText, heading/paragraph/anchor collection, JSON-LD walk) from page.ts plus extractNormalisedBody/decodeHtml from packages/crawler/src/extract.ts. Dropped all @signalframe/core types and inferPageRole (engine infers role later); dropped contentHash (crypto) and the date/claim-cue/image-alt observers not in the CrawlPageProjection contract. Reshaped output to the ParsedPage subset of CrawlPageProjection: link targets are canonicalized via canonicalizeUrl to targetSubjectUrl (same-origin only) instead of raw absolute URLs; robots meta parsed into robotsDirectives[]+robotsIndexable; jsonLd reduced to {types,errorCount}; added bodyExcerpt and bounded paragraph/heading/outlink counts. Rewrote import specifiers to explicit .ts.

Vendored parseGroups/globMatches/longest-match Allow-wins logic from robots.ts and the AI-crawler UA names from packages/crawler/src/ai-bots.ts (OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot). Dropped @signalframe/core CrawlerAccessRule and the monitored-bot report/kind taxonomy. Reshaped to CrawlRobotsProjection: projection.groups preserve every file user-agent group and guarantee an entry per required AI bot (resolved from its dedicated group else the * group). Added productToken() so the own-crawler gate matches 'SignalFrameBot/0.2' against a 'signalframebot' group; exposed isPathAllowed(groups,ua,path) + emptyRobots().

Vendored the regex <loc> extraction + urlset/sitemapindex detection + decodeXml from sitemap.ts. Added index recursion, same-origin filtering, canonicalizeUrl-to-subjectUrl mapping, dedupe, and depth/document/url bounds, delegating HTTP to an injected fetchText so every fetch still passes the SSRF guard + shared budget. Output reshaped to CrawlSitemapProjection {fetched,urlCount,subjectUrls}.

Vendored the BFS loop, manual-redirect-with-per-hop-guard logic, byte-capped streaming body read, and host-delay pacing from crawl.ts. Replaced the undici fetch + createPinnedAgent transport with the injected CrawlFetcher (default createDefaultCrawlFetcher wraps globalThis.fetch with redirect:'manual' + UA header). Dropped @signalframe/core SiteSnapshot/PageRecord/inferPageRole and the llms.txt + internal-link-depth analytics. Output reshaped to CrawlRaw; all CRAWL_BUDGET limits enforced (maxUrls/maxDepth/wall-clock/maxRedirects+SSRF re-check each hop/maxBodyBytes/perHostConcurrency/minHostDelay/robots); on any budget cut returns availability:'partial' with a specific stopReason and keeps collected pages; fills providerUsage + a non-empty limitation. Guard/now/budget injectable as test-only seams; every crawled URL and link target canonicalized via canonicalizeUrl.
